title: The Selfish Giant
mainIdea: Being selfish can hurt others and take away their happiness.

pages.text: The children loved playing in the Giant's beautiful garden after school.

question.text: Who is one of the main characters?

pages.text: The garden had green grass, flowers, fruit trees, and singing birds.

options: Climbing the mountains near the town

pages.text: One day, the Giant returned home and saw the children playing.

question.text: What problem began in the story?
options: The garden disappeared behind a thick grey wall of fog
The Giant became angry when he saw the children
The children broke the trees while they were playing

pages.text: The Giant told the children to leave and built a high wall around the garden.

options: He invited the children to stay and play all day
He chased the children away and built a wall

pages.text: The children sadly lost their favorite place to play.

options: The children continued playing in the garden every day
The children could no longer play in the garden

elements.correct: To keep the garden only for himself
distractors: To share the garden with everyone

elements.correct: He chased them away and built a wall
distractors: He invited the children to stay

elements.correct: The children lost their favorite place to play
distractors: The children found a new garden to play in
The children helped the Giant fix his wall
